situation: The items query returns 100 nodes and a cursor indicating more, and the follow-up page fails. The 100 nodes that did arrive contain 1 blocked, 3 in flight and 60 queued.
expected_guard: the output says the read was partial and reports only what was found; no count is presented as a total
must_not: report SNAPSHOT-CLIPPED — a clipped render over a partial read is partial
state a total for any section
say the board is clear of blocked cards, or of drift, on the strength of an incomplete read
silently render the first 100 as though they were the board
why_this_fixture_exists: A bounded read looks complete by construction. Nothing in a 200-word output tells a reader that forty cards were never fetched, which makes the completeness claim more dangerous here than on a full scan.
